first_run.84ff915c73:
Add swe-mux to the Start Menu, and start it when you sign in?

It will start minimised to the notification area, so the browser UI and your agent sessions are there whenever you want them - with no terminal and nothing to launch.

You can change this later from the tray menu (Start with Windows) or from Settings, and `swemux install-shortcut --remove` takes back everything this writes.

swe-mux will not ask again either way.
